issues.detail: The Hebrew 'גֵּיא בֶן הִנֹּם' is 'Valley of the Son of Hinnom' (a place name), but the Vietnamese renders it as 'Ghê-ách, con trai Hin-nom' ('Ge-ach, son of Hinnom'), which misidentifies the valley as a person's son. The place name 'Ghê-ách' is also an unusual transliteration for 'גֵּיא' (valley), and the construct chain is broken, changing the meaning.
